# Conversation events

## CONVERSATION\_END { #event-25 }

```aa2m
on CONVERSATION_END
```

The event is fired when a conversation ends between two cards.

**Example**

```aa2m
trigger "Example" {
  on CONVERSATION_END;
}
```

Native name: Conversation End (Conversation). ID: `event-25`

## NPC\_AFTER\_RESPONSE { #event-20 }

```

```

Native name: After NPC Response (Conversation). ID: `event-20`

## NPC\_RESPONSE { #event-8 }

```aa2m
on NPC_RESPONSE
```

Whenever a NPC made a yes/no decision, no matter if towards the PC or another NPC. Triggering Card is the NPC that gives the Answer.

**Example**

```aa2m
trigger "Example" {
  on NPC_RESPONSE;
}
```

Native name: Npc Answers in a Conversation (Conversation). ID: `event-8`
